_note: Packages lessons may declare in "packages". Versions must equal those shipped by Pyodide 0.27.8 (pyodide-lock.json); the content gate and CI install exactly these. Keys starting with _ are metadata. _import_names maps a package to its import name when the two differ (e.g. "scikit-learn": "sklearn"). _cpython_modules lists packages that are part of CPython's standard library but that Pyodide ships separately and loads on demand (their version is Pyodide's lockfile version); the content gate checks that they import instead of checking a pip version.
